drills.title: Form Shooting — Close Range
drills.description: One-motion shots from 3–5 feet, focused entirely on a straight shot line: elbow under the ball, shoulders square, perfect release every rep.
coachingPoints: Start with the ball in your shot pocket, elbow directly under it.
Square both shoulders to the rim before you begin the shot.
Finish with your fingers in the rim — hold the follow-through until the ball hits the net.
Make 5 in a row before stepping back one foot.

drills.title: One-Hand Form Shots
drills.description: Shoot close-range with only your shooting hand. Without the guide hand, the ball flight tells you the truth about your release.
coachingPoints: Guide arm behind your back or at your side.
Balance the ball on your shooting hand, wrist loaded back.
Snap the wrist fully — the ball should have clear backspin.
If the ball drifts sideways, your elbow or wrist is off-line.

drills.title: Wall Sits + Shot Pocket
drills.description: Build leg strength and groove the dip: hold a wall sit while moving the ball from triple threat to shot pocket on a rhythm count.
coachingPoints: Thighs parallel to the floor, back flat on the wall.
Move the ball to the pocket on a 1-2 rhythm, exhale on the lift.
Keep the dip small and smooth — no yanking the ball down.
30 seconds on, 30 seconds rest.

drills.title: Guide-Hand Discipline
drills.description: Catch-and-shoot reps where the guide hand releases early and opens flat. Cures thumb pushes and sideways spin.
coachingPoints: Guide hand on the side of the ball, fingers to the sky.
Peel the guide hand off as the ball starts up past your chin.
After release, your guide palm should face the sideline, not the rim.
Check the spin: pure backspin means the guide hand stayed quiet.

drills.title: Follow-Through Freeze
drills.description: Every shot ends in a statue: full extension, wrist snapped, eyes on target — held for a full two seconds.
coachingPoints: Freeze until the ball hits the floor — no exceptions.
Elbow above your eyebrow, fingers pointing down in the rim.
If you fall off balance during the freeze, your base needs work.
Have a partner call out 'early' if your arm drops before two seconds.

drills.title: 1-2 Step Rhythm Shooting
drills.description: Catch off a self-toss with a 1-2 step, syncing the ball lift to the legs so everything rises as one spring.
coachingPoints: Toss, catch on the hop or 1-2 — legs load AS the ball arrives.
Say '1-2-up' out loud; the ball starts rising on 'up' with the legs.
No pause at the pocket: the catch flows straight into the shot.
Film a rep: ball and hips should start rising within a frame or two.

drills.title: Mirror Set-Point Checks
drills.description: Slow-motion shots in front of a mirror, pausing at the set point to check ball height and position before finishing.
coachingPoints: Pause 2 seconds at your set point — ball above your eyebrow, in front of your head.
The ball should never drift behind your hairline.
Watch the path: pocket to set point in one straight lift.
Do 5 slow-motion reps, then 5 at game speed keeping the same positions.

drills.title: No-Dip Catch & Shoot
drills.description: Partner or self-toss feeds at pocket height; shoot without lowering the ball. Builds a compact, hitch-free release.
coachingPoints: Show target hands at your shot pocket before the catch.
The ball only goes UP after the catch — zero downward drift.
No pause at the set point; catch-to-release is one count.
If your rhythm dies, allow a small dip and shrink it every set.

drills.title: Chair Shooting
drills.description: Start seated, stand and shoot in one motion. Forces the legs to initiate the shot and the kinetic chain to fire in order.
coachingPoints: Sit tall on the chair edge, ball in the pocket.
Drive through your heels — legs start the shot, arms finish it.
The ball leaves your hand just before your legs finish extending.
If you shoot all-arms, lower the chair height or slow down.

drills.title: Wall Posture Shots
drills.description: Shooting motion with your heels, hips and shoulders brushing a wall — teaches a tall spine and level head through the shot.
coachingPoints: Heels two inches from the wall; hips and shoulders lightly touch it.
Rise into the shot without your head drifting forward off the wall line.
Eyes lock on a target spot the whole rep.
Do it with no ball first, then with a ball, no hoop needed.

drills.title: Eyes-on-Rim Freeze
drills.description: Shots where the only goal is a still head and square shoulders: pick your target early, never let your eyes or chin move.
coachingPoints: Pick the back of the rim as your target before the ball arrives.
Chin stays level — no head bob as you rise.
A partner watches your eyes: any flick to the ball flight is a miss.
Finish square: both shoulders still facing the rim after release.

drills.title: Quick-Release Countdown
drills.description: Game-speed catch and shoot against a countdown: get the shot off in under one second without breaking your mechanics.
coachingPoints: Partner counts down '3-2-1' — the ball must be gone on '1'.
Speed comes from starting the release on the way up, not rushing the arms.
Keep the follow-through even at speed; never trade form for time.
If form breaks, add half a second back and rebuild.
